other.name: 株式会社ポイント・ピクチャーズ

segments.text: "Hey, Delta! How long are you gonna sleep?! Don't you need to open?"
Age: Around 21 (appearance-wise 15)
Singer: Yoshino Nanjo
A girl living in the human city of Felion.
She is able to use Song Magic, an art that changes thoughts into magic. With this ability, she is currently an active member of the Divine Empress' PLASMA special forces team.

She is also part of the Genomis task force, which was assigned only to select members of PLASMA, but she refuses to find a permanent partner for the required two-person squads, so she sees little deployment.
She helps out in Delta's restaurant on weekends. She is the self-proclaimed poster girl of the restaurant, whatever that means...
From the English official site

cast.characterName: イオナサル・ククルル・プリシェール
cast.originalCharacterName: イオナサル・ククルル・プリシェール

segments.text: "Plus, I think I'd be better at making a bomb than a pickaxe!"
Singer: Akiko Shikata
Ciel Nosurge Description:

The protagonist of Ciel nosurge, and the empress candidate of the Tenmon (Astronomical faction) group. Unsure of herself, she wants to do what she can to save Ra Ciela but lacks conviction at first, especially compared to the fiery and determined Kanon. Ion is quite the gearhead, and loves tinkering with machinery.
From Ciel Nosurge Summary
Ar Nosurge Description:
Nicknamed Ion, her actual name is Ionasal kkll Preciell.
This girl is said to know the truths of the world. She has no allegiances to anyone, but her current location is unknown.
She is somewhat awkward, and loves to tinker with machines.
Whenever she has the chance, she gathers strange materials together to create devices of unknown purpose.
From the English official site
"It's not junk. These may be older models, but they're still perfectly usable."
Age: Around 20s (appearance-wise 10)
A mechanical engineer associated with Felion's PLASMA force.
Ever since she was a child, she was a brilliant student with mechanical aptitude, and has been a genius hacker for as long as she can remember.
Since going to PLASMA, she continued to exhibit talents in creating chemical weapons, crafting simple medicines, writing software, and more.
Despite her relative youth, she is something of a technological guru. She is currently carrying out a secret mission in Quanturv.
From the English official site
"No! No! No! No! No! No! No! No! No!"
A female "Incarnate" who wields the capability to channel Song Magic using a human voice, and is also a Genom who can weave Song Magic.
As an Incarnate, she is capable of using Song Magic on her own, which is a rarity among the near-extinct Genom.
From the English official site

cast.characterName: レナルル・タータルカ
cast.originalCharacterName: レナルル・タータルカ

segments.text: "Assist Her Majesty the Empress."
This woman is a member of the "Tenmon" organization that once tried to estalish Ion as Empress of Ra Ciela.
Despite her youth, she held a high position within Tenmon through her intelligence and talent.
She often took a harsh stance with others, but was more tender with Ion, who she viewed as something of a younger sister.
Her location on the Orei is still unknown.
From the English official site

cast.characterName: カノイール・ククルル・プリシェール
cast.originalCharacterName: カノイール・ククルル・プリシェール

segments.text: "...I have to go as well. There must be something I can do."
Singer: Origa
Also known as Kanon.
A young girl who challenged Ion for the throne of Empress of the planet Ra Ciela.
At the tender age of 9, she exhibited amazing talent by succesfully forming a pact with the Genom king, Cosal, but she does not overestimate her own abilities.
She continued taking counsel from the people in order to gain support for her bid for the Imperial seat.
Like Ion, her current whereabouts are unknown.
From the English official site

cast.characterName: デルタ・ランタノイル
cast.originalCharacterName: デルタ・ランタノイル

segments.text: "It's just a gut feeling... I just know it's all going to work out."
A young man who came from within the Barrier of Felion when it opened.
He protected humans from attacks by the Sharl as a member of the Divine Empress' PLASMA special forces team.
He was part of the Genomis task force, which was assigned only to select members of PLASMA, but was discharged from the unit after a certain incident.
He is currently running a small restaurant in Felion that he named "Cook de Delta".
From the English official site
"Everyone, remain calm! Nay the Gale is here!"
Singer: Haruka Shimotsuki
Nicknamed Nay, full name Nayaflask. She is friends with Delta, Casty and Sarly.
She lives in Felion, but also shows up when the Sharl are attacked by humans.
It seems she assists everyone with a great deal of goodwill, and is quite popular.
It could be that her very straightforward attitude and blunt way of speaking are part of her overall popularity.
From the English official site

Naya was the original Tenmon Empress Candidate, but lost her position and original body when Fractal removed her soul for the transmigration to give the body to the current Ion on Revelt's orders, and her soul was put into the body of a Sharl. She meets Ion, in hopes of getting revenge and reclaim her original body, but eventually becomes great friends with her.
"I know how I look, but I'm a real administrator!"
A young female artificial life form known as a Reyvateil, created to oversee the Ar Tonelico tower that supports Sol Ciel.
Her unfathomable abilities are such that she alone is capable of managing the tower that supports the entire planet, and she exudes an aura of divinity.
Her actual self is quite awkward, and she seems to be a natural klutz who gets lost, falls down, and causes the most mind-blowing problems.
She also likes the sound of an unusual animal called the Usako.
From the English official site

cast.characterName: ジリリウム・リモナイト
cast.originalCharacterName: ジリリウム・リモナイト

segments.text: "Welcome to the Genomirai Church. Let us work together for the betterment of humanity and this world, alongside the Sharl."
Also known as "Zill", this woman of indeterminate age holds the position of Archbishop of the Genomirai Church withing the city of Guanturv.
She preaches of the ability of humans and Sharl to coexist, and sends her followers on missions and trials throughout Orei.
She believes that the Sharl are a higher order of life than humanity, and thus wishes to build a world of peace based on this ideology.
This has greatly affected the stature of the Genomirai Church.
From the English official site
"Well, that's rude. I'm Nelico, the glamorous, beautiful shopkeeper!"
A mysterious woman who runs the general store near Ion's home.
She groans about being bored at every opportunity, and will always tease Ion if she has the chance.
A happy-go-lucky free spirit, she hates dull things and trouble, basically passing such issues on to others.
She takes pride in her charming ears and in her drop-dead gorgeous body.
From the English official site
In reality, Nelico is a parasite attached to Ion's brain.
"...Please, just let me go home."
A girl who has had interactions with Ion and Casty in the past.
She is searching for her home, but her current location is unknown.
Her emotions rarely change, and she dislikes any actions that go against her own goals.
From the English official site
"I'm Tatoria. I run a shop in the village over there."
A Sharl boy who operates a medicine shop in Honokano Village.
He is always seen with a small animal-type Genom named Vio.
He has a strange fascination with the ruins near the village, Kurt Himmel, but every time he tries to go there, he is reprimanded by Vio.
From the English official site
"Anyway, let us introduce ourselves. I am the head of the Ayatane, Karyou Kirinami. It's a pleasure to meet you."
A man who guards the Ar Tonelico tower on the planet Ar Ciel.
He speaks and acts in a kindly manner, but is very stern and honest when it comes to his work.
The name "Ayatane" is passed down as the title of his clan chief.
This man's birth name is Karyou Kirinami.
From the English official site
"This is a lot different from your average figure. Just look at these moving parts!"
An old friend of Casty and Sarly. He is currently missing.
He encountered Ion while he was running a Bios Shop, and helped her and Casty on their travels.
He has a detail knowledge of idols and figurines, and knows a great deal about sub-culture.
He has something of a geeky way of speaking when discussing his passions, including "Moe", but he is also a talented hacker and held a key position within a prominent hacking clan.
He is very knowledgeable on Wave Science, computer hacking, and Genometrics Networking.
From the English official site
A strange combat robot. Nothing about its origins or manufacturing are known, but with its armaments, it's a pretty good bet that it was created with fighting in mind.
From English official site
You, the player. You have been controlling Delta and Earthes through technology developed by the inhabitants of the Soreil.

Another player playing Ar Nosurge, from Nero's home universe. They are cruel and want nothing more than to achieve "100% completion" by killing all the characters. They are controlling Prim's body and voice, and using her to attack and harm others.
